page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.10xlarge is a KVM-hypervised virtual machine instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. This x86_64 architecture server features 40 dedicated physical cores running at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz, with 1.0 thread per core. It is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 4.8 GB per core. The instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage, and offers a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations place the ecs.hfg6.10xlarge in the average performance tier across multiple workloads. The Intel Xeon processor achieves a single-core stress-ng score of 1438.99 and a multi-core score of 38378.07, supported by AVX-512 vector extensions. Memory performance is characterized by a cached read bandwidth of 2133.36 GB/sec and an uncached large-block write speed of 48.09 GB/sec. In application-specific tests, the instance demonstrates strong database capabilities, achieving 34.78 million operations per second in Redis SET tests and a Passmark database score of 14249.04. It also handles light LLM inference, processing 56.94 prompt tokens per second on a 7B parameter model.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation and high clock speed of 3.1 GHz deliver predictable compute performance without the resource contention typical of shared-core instances. However, the lack of bundled local storage and GPUs means users must factor in the cost of external block storage and avoid workloads requiring hardware acceleration. This resource profile makes the ecs.hfg6.10xlarge highly suitable for CPU-bound applications, software compilation, database operations, and static web serving.
